## WrapperSpec.shellBuiltin property

Whether this wrapper represents a shell builtin rather than an external utility. A path cannot reach a builtin: `/tmp/command` names an external executable, so its arguments must not be interpreted as builtin operands. When true, only exact entries in [WrapperSpec.names](./sh-ast-analyze.wrapperspec.names.md) match; the absolute-path final-segment fallback is disabled. Explicitly listed path entries still match exactly. False or omitted preserves utility matching. The defaults mark `command` and `exec`<!-- -->; custom tables may mark their own builtins, such as `builtin`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly shellBuiltin?: boolean;
```
